notes: Read SKILL.md, references/details.md and references/advanced-patterns.md in full. The skill teaches Python profiling (cProfile, line_profiler, memory_profiler, py-spy, tracemalloc) and optimization patterns (comprehensions, generators, join, dict lookups, NumPy, lru_cache, __slots__, multiprocessing, asyncio/aiohttp, batched DB writes, weakref caches, pytest-benchmark).

Commands are local profiling runs (python -m cProfile, kernprof, py-spy against a PID or script); `pip install` appears only as '# Install:' comments naming well-known PyPI profilers. No credentials or state-changing operations.

The async I/O benchmark (advanced-patterns.md:161-198) makes live requests to the public httpbin.org test service if run as-is. py-spy attaching to a running process may need elevated privileges on the user's machine.
